name: spyglass
description: Marketing research with Spyglass: find brands, creators, ads, campaigns, and landing pages.

interface.longDescription:
Spyglass is a marketing research and analytics tool for exploring indexed advertising and brand content. Search brands, creators, ads, and organic posts; analyze creative patterns; and inspect campaigns, comments, and landing pages. Marketing teams, creative strategists, agencies, and researchers can use these findings to compare competitors and inform creative briefs.

Connect your existing Spyglass account to access its research tools in ChatGPT. Results reflect content indexed by Spyglass and do not establish actual advertising spend, sales, or return on investment.
defaultPrompt: Find skincare brands using creator-led ads.
Analyze creative patterns in a competitor’s ads.

publication.release_notes: Updates the Spyglass square icon to the new white mark on black. No changes to tools or skills.
